<!-- merge-digest:begin -->
## Merge digest

**What changed:** `/pr-burndown` now rebases only PRs with a merge conflict and leaves PRs that are just behind master to the merge line.

**Why:** Rebasing several approved PRs at once wasted CI runs, because master takes one PR and the rest fall behind again.

**Watch:** A `BEHIND` PR that post-plan never arms now stays behind master until someone rebases it, because `.github/workflows/update-behind-prs.yml` updates only armed PRs.

**Touches:** `.claude/skills/pr-burndown/SKILL.md`

**Machine-authored fixes:** Phase 6.5 edited only the PR body, adding a `## Declared scope` section and rewording its owner-request clause to "owner request not recorded in this PR". (post-plan remediation: body-only)
<!-- merge-digest:end -->

## Summary
- Updates `.claude/skills/pr-burndown/SKILL.md` so the skill rebases only `DIRTY` PRs. A `BEHIND` PR with no conflict gets no rebase from this skill.
- Adds a section, "Rebase only what the merge line can't fix", that explains why. Master takes a PR only when it is up to date, so rebasing several approved PRs at once makes all but one fall behind again.
- Points to the merge line that already handles `BEHIND` PRs: `.github/workflows/update-behind-prs.yml`, `bin/merge-line-watch` and `bin/merge-line-select`, which update the oldest armed PR with no conflict and no red required check (ADR-0081).
- Adds ordering rules. When two approved PRs clash with each other, rebase and ship the higher-ranked one first and hold the other's rebase until it merges. Post-plan is re-fired in Step 2 rank order so PRs arm, and merge, in that order.
- Rewords the ranking text and the status card text so a `BEHIND` branch is not described as getting a rebase in Step 6. The Conflicts line now says when a PR rebases after another PR merges.
- Changes the job prompt template so step 2 rebases only when the PR is `DIRTY`. A `BEHIND`-only PR is told not to rebase or merge master.
- Bumps `last_verified` to 2026-11-11.
- No code, workflow or script changes. Only skill prose changed.

**Merge danger:** Door: two-way · Blast radius: localized · Why: Edits one skill prose file that guides the burndown agent. No code, data or workflow runs differently until the skill is used.
**How to revert:** `git revert <merge-sha>`. No migration, prod sync or config is touched.


## Declared scope

- `.claude/skills/pr-burndown/SKILL.md`: the whole purpose of this PR. It has no plan. It changes when `/pr-burndown` rebases (only `DIRTY` PRs). Owner request not recorded in this PR.

## Manual Testing

No manual testing needed — all changes are covered by automated tests.
title: docs(pr-burndown): stop wasted rebases of PRs the merge line updates
